Name: Skimpy Anime Portraits Seasonal Bachelorettes
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[u]✨ Skimpy Portraits – Seasonal Bachelorettes (AI Replacer) ✨[/u]

Hey there! 🙋‍♀️
Welcome to my very first Stardew Valley mod ever – a big, slightly over-the-top portrait overhaul for the [b]bachelorettes[/b], built on top of [b]Mud’s Skimpy Portraits Overhaul – Bachelorettes (Mud is the best :))[/b].

All portraits were created with [b]AI assistance[/b] and then manually edited, cleaned up and adjusted by me to fit into a consistent pack.

I’m absolutely [i]not[/i] a professional artist or veteran modder – this is my first real project – so this mod is currently in an [b]alpha state[/b], and I’m genuinely happy about [b]constructive feedback, bug reports and suggestions for improvement[/b]. 💖
[u]
[/u][u]🌸 What does this mod do?In short:[/u]

[b]Big, pretty, skimpy portraits for all six bachelorettes – with seasonal and location-based logic.[/b]
Supported NPCs:
[list]
[*][b]Penny[/b]
[*][b]Abigail[/b]
[*][b]Haley[/b]
[*][b]Leah[/b]
[*][b]Emily[/b]
[*][b]Maru[/b]
[/list][b]Dynamic outfits depending on season & location:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Indoors[/b] → always the [b]normal portrait[/b] (no matter the season)
[*][b]Outdoors in Spring & Fall[/b] → normal outfit
[*][b]Outdoors in Summer[/b] → [b]beach/summer outfit[/b]
[*][b]Outdoors in Winter[/b] → [b]winter outfit[/b] (warmer but still stylish 😏)
[*][b]At the Beach (map: Beach) in Spring & Summer[/b] → always beach outfit when you talk to them there
[/list]All of this happens automatically through Content Patcher:
The game checks [b]season, whether the NPC is indoors/outdoors, and the current location[/b] and chooses the matching portrait.

[line]
🧠 Technical OverviewThis mod is a [b]replacer/extension[/b] for the existing skimpy setup, not a standalone.

[list]
[*]Replaces and extends portraits from:
[list]
[*][b]Mud’s Skimpy Portraits Overhaul – Bachelorettes[/b] ([code]Mud.SkimpyPortraits[/code])
[/list][*]Designed to work nicely with:
[list]
[*][b]ScaleUp (Unofficial Fork)[/b] ([code]Arborsm.ScaleUpUnofficial[/code]) – for enlarged character sprites
[*][b]Dialogue Display Framework (Continued)[/b] ([code]Mangupix.DialogueDisplayFrameworkContinued[/code]) – so big portraits look good in the dialogue box
[/list][/list]Portrait variants per bachelorette:
[list]
[*][code]Name.png[/code] – standard
[*][code]Name_Beach.png[/code] – summer/beach outfit
[*][code]Name_Winter.png[/code] – winter outfit
[*][code]Name_Swims.png[/code] & [code]Name_SwimsEX.png[/code] – swimsuit variants kept for compatibility with the original skimpy logic
[/list]All images are [b]AI-generated and then manually edited[/b] – please keep that in mind when giving feedback about style or anatomy. I’m still learning and will keep polishing things over time. 🙈
[line]
🔧 Installation[list=1]
[*][b]Install all requirements first:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Mud’s Skimpy Portraits Overhaul – Bachelorettes
[*]ScaleUp (Unofficial)
[*]Dialogue Display Framework (Continued)
[/list]
[*][b]Install this mod:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and extract the ZIP into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.
[/list]
[*][b]Important: configure Mud’s Skimpy Portraits mod options[/b]
In order for [b]my seasonal & location-based outfits to actually show[/b], you need to make sure Mud’s own swimsuit/summer logic is [b]disabled[/b]:
[list]
[*]Start the game with SMAPI.
[*]Open the [b]Mod Options / Mod Config[/b] menu (e.g. via Generic Mod Config Menu).
[*]Go to the settings for [b]Mud’s Skimpy Portraits Overhaul – Bachelorettes[/b].
[*][b]Turn OFF / uncheck everything related to:[/b]
[list]
[*]Summer swimsuit outfits
[*]“Lewd / Lewder” summer outfits
[*]Any other toggles that automatically force Mud’s own summer/swimsuit portraits
[/list][*]In short: [b]disable all Summer / Swimsuit / Lewder outfit options in Mud’s menu[/b], so they don’t override the seasonal logic from this replacer.
[/list]If those options stay enabled, you’ll see Mud’s original summer/“lewd” outfits instead of the new seasonal portraits from this mod.

[*][b]Launch the game via SMAPI:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI should list this mod as loaded.
[*]The bachelorettes should now use the large portraits.
[*]Outfits should change depending on:
[list]
[*]Season
[*]Indoors vs outdoors
[*]Whether you’re talking to them at the Beach in Spring/Summer
[/list][/list]
[/list]If something looks off, check your SMAPI log and other portrait mods that might conflict.
[line]⚠️ [u]Status: Alpha & Possible IssuesThis mod is:[/u]

[list]
[*]my [b]first mod ever[/b]
[*]in an [b]alpha[/b] stage
[*]tested, but definitely not guaranteed bug-free
[/list]So you might encounter:
[list]
[*]wrong portraits in certain events
[*]mismatched outfits in edge cases
[*]minor glitches or inconsistencies
[/list]If you notice anything strange:
[list]
[*]Please send [b]constructive feedback[/b] ❤️
[*]Ideally include:
[list]
[*]Which NPC?
[*]Where (map / location)?
[*]Which season and weather?
[*]Screenshot if possible
[*]SMAPI log (via smapi.io/log)
[/list][/list][b]IMPORTANT[/b]: The more details, the easier it is for me to fix it. [b]IMPORTANT[/b][line]🤝 Collaboration – Sprite Artist(s) Wanted!Right now this mod focuses mainly on [b]portraits[/b].
The sprites are either from existing mods (ScaleUp etc.) or vanilla-based.
I would [b]love to collaborate[/b] with someone who:
[list]
[*]enjoys making [b]character sprites[/b]
[*]is interested in matching the [b]sprites[/b] to the [b]new portraits[/b] (outfits, colours, overall vibe)
[*]maybe wants to help expand this into a more complete [b]visual overhaul[/b] of the bachelorettes
[/list]If you:
[list]
[*]can draw sprites,
[*]want to practice on a real project,
[*]or just feel like co-creating this mod,
[/list]please reach out!
Even small contributions (a single character, one outfit, experimental versions) are super welcome. I’m happy to credit you prominently on the Nexus page and in the mod files.

If You like to support me:

【 💖 [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/tyr4ntx]Buy Me a Coffee [/url]💖 】


[line]❤️ Credits & Huge ThanksThis mod wouldn’t exist without the work of other amazing modders and tool creators.
Massive thanks to:
[list]
[*][b][TheMud][/b]
for the original skimpy portrait concept & framework[*][b][ScaleUp / Arborsm.Unofficial][/b]
for the enlarged character sprites that make everything pop[*][b][MangusuPixel][/b]
for the framework that makes big portraits look great in dialogues[*][b]Pathoschild[/b]
for SMAPI and Content Patcher – the backbone of pretty much everything[*]The entire [b]Stardew Valley modding community[/b] for guides, tools and inspiration ✨
[/list][line]✉️ Final wordsI hope you’ll have as much fun playing with these portraits as I had creating them.
Please be a bit gentle – I’m still learning – but [b]honest, constructive feedback is absolutely appreciated[/b] and will help this mod grow from a small alpha experiment into something really polished.
Have fun in the valley – and try not to catch a cold staring at all those beach outfits. 😄💦
